response.message: Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival 2023 will take place from April 14 to April 23, 2023 at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California. Headliners include Bad Bunny, Blackpink, and Frank Ocean.
Glastonbury Festival 2023 is scheduled for June 21-25, 2023 at Worthy Farm in Pilton, Somerset, England. The lineup features Arctic Monkeys, Guns N' Roses, and Elton John.
Lollapalooza 2023 will be held from August 3-6, 2023 at Grant Park in Chicago, Illinois. Performers include Kendrick Lamar, Billie Eilish, and Red Hot Chili Peppers.
